statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The service was denied under reason code CO-22
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate arrhythmic burden and optimize anticoagulation management
The submitted clinical indication note supports the medical necessity of this service
